title: Foundation in Crypto Regulation and Compliance
description: The Foundation in Crypto Regulation and Compliance Course is catered for professionals in regulatory bodies, financial institutions, and compliance roles, especially those with a passion and curiosity for crypto. Designed by leading industry experts and academics, this 16-hour online program provides regulators and compliance professionals with a comprehensive understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrency, and financial regulations. Participants will also gain hands-on insights into numerous important areas such as AML/KYC compliance and financial crime prevention, blockchain forensics and cross-border regulatory frameworks, RegTech solutions, and more. By the end of the course, attendees will be well-equipped to tackle compliance challenges, mitigate risks, and adapt to the evolving crypto landscape.

quizzes.title: Module 2 Quiz
quizzes.description: Test your knowledge of crypto regulations and compliance

questions.question_text: What is listed as a primary impetus for crypto regulations?

options.option_text: Increasing use of crypto-assets in illicit activities.
The desire to ban all crypto-assets.

questions.question_text: What key risk in the digital assets ecosystem is FATF instrumental in driving global standards for?
IOSCO recommends regulators analyze the applicability and adequacy of regulatory frameworks, considering if crypto-assets are or behave like substitutes for what?
What is a proposed measure for DPTSPs to safeguard private keys and customer DPTs?

options.option_text: Allow any staff to authorize movement of client DPTs.
Storing all customer assets in hot wallets
Storing a high proportion of customer assets in cold wallets.

questions.question_text: The Financial Services and Markets Act (FSMA) now regulates a new class of Financial Institutions (FIs). What does this new class cover?

options.option_text: Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs) created in Singapore that provide DT services outside of Singapore

questions.question_text: What is excluded from the scope of DT services under FSMA?

options.option_text: Technical Service Providers that do not possess any money or DT.

questions.question_text: What is the key test for whether crypto assets are subject to Traditional Finance (TradFi) regulations?

options.option_text: The current market capitalization of the crypto asset.
The underlying economic structure and impact of the crypto asset.
The number of exchanges the crypto asset is listed on.

questions.question_text: What is the general regulatory stance on NFTs in most jurisdictions, including Singapore?

options.option_text: They are fully regulated as securities
They are considered traditional financial instruments.

questions.question_text: What is a mitigation strategy for "Customer Risk" concerning ML/TF purposes?

options.option_text: Implementing Customer Identification Program (CIP) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD).

questions.question_text: What does FATF's Travel Rule mandate for VASPs?

options.option_text: They must use only specific blockchain networks.
They must send, receive, and screen personal/business information for crypto transactions over a certain monetary threshold.
They must report all transactions to a central authority, regardless of value.
